title: ticfac Phase 7: cut over and simplify ticks
description: SPEC §12 Phase 7. Release ticfac and the required tk version/contracts together; remove Factory/cloud commands, packages, embedding, cloud image assets and Factory CI from ticks; remove duplicate execution/orchestration implementations while retaining tracker authoring policy, sandbox contracts, question state and the board; prove the dependency direction mechanically.
notes: 2026-09-26 operator decisions supersede 'retaining sandbox contracts and the board': ticfac OWNS the sandbox image (image/), the tk sandbox/cloud-branch verbs the image runs, and every contract describing a ticfac/factory format; ticks keeps only tk-json-manifest + tracker-layout (bundle 7.0.0); the ticks.sh cloud board is retired. ticks side: ticks epic chz (ticks becomes tracker-only). ticks main can drop the code first because ticfac pins ticks commits; the ticks below must land before ticfac moves factory.pin.json, sandbox.pin.json or contracts.pin.json past chz.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: ticks builds without ticfac; ticfac passes the contract bundle against a pinned ticks release. Project checkpoint.
